definition: with a surface free of bumps or roughness
description: A woman in a yellow top and white flared trousers stands barefoot on a wooden-topped hydrofoil board that is lifted clear of the water on a thin mast. The harbour water is completely flat and mirror-like, reflecting her and the palm trees, and she glides across it leaving only a thin line of ripples. She rides past a breakwater of grey concrete blocks and a marina, then comes back in and steps off onto a floating plastic dock.

de.answer: Sie fährt über das glatte Wasser.
